name: Admin Accounting Expenses CRUD
description: Superuser manages expense records at /panel/accounting/expenses with category (Negocio/Personal) and ledger (Contabilidad) badges, partner split (hidden for personal-ledger expenses, which use a single Valor field) and the same modal CRUD + filters pattern as incomes; the leading three-dots menu of each row offers Detalle e historial, Ver nota when the record has a note, Editar and Eliminar with confirmation. Money inputs live-format es-CO thousands separators (BaseCurrencyInput). Since Jul 2026 the modal has a 'Registrar egreso en bolsillo' toggle (on by default): on creates/keeps a linked pocket OUT movement (bidirectional sync, edits/deletes mirror/cascade), off covers paper adjustments and expenses that never touched the pocket; a personal-ledger expense with the toggle on is stored as a company draw (ledger company, full split to the owner, warning hint in the modal) so pocket money always counts against company utility; on edit the toggle can link/unlink deliberately. Since Aug 2026 the period field captures the exact date by default ('Fecha', prefilled with today, shared PeriodDateField) with a toggle down to month-only ('Mes'); edits always open in full-date mode showing the stored day (01 for month-only records; the toggle still downgrades to month) and the backend already renders full dates as '17 Julio 2026'. Since Aug 2026 deductions are first-class in the tab: a 'Tipo de deducción' multi filter (shared catalog with the liquidation modal), Operativo/Deducciones chips over the filtered rows, a 'Deducciones (año)' KPI card with the per-type breakdown, the pill tooltip naming the origin income (source_income link), and the edit modal hiding the pocket toggle behind a hint for deduction rows — they are created from Liquidar only and reduce utility under the gross-income convention.
